note: Retronet ICQ cross-list roster — the single source for the contact seeder (scripts/retronet/icq/seed_contacts.py). Each live station carries every OTHER live station + the bot in its contact list. Adding a station is ONE row here, then re-run `seed_contacts.py ssi --apply`. UIN/tier table: docs/lab/retronet/ICQ-ONBOARDING-PLAN.md. nick = the display name (SSI 0x0131 alias TLV in the server-side roster; also the ICQ directory nickname), never a bare UIN. client = which fallback client-UI seeding driver applies. onboarded=true means LIVE: it gates the SSI cross-list (only live stations appear in each other's rosters). Primary path is SSI/feedbag (`ssi`); the client-UI `seed`/`plan` path is the non-SSI ICQ 2000b fallback.
